name: tpl-existence-3-goal
task: Get into the locked room and pick up the ball.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task commands two events — 'Get into the locked room' and 'pick up the ball' — with no order word between them ('and', not 'then' or 'before'), so a hard Existence(target_room_entered) and a hard Existence(target_picked_up) are exactly right. The machine reaches its final state u3 only when both have happened. The intermediate prerequisites (key, door) are unstated and already forced by the environment, so their omission is correct.

machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !target_picked_up&target_room_entered) -> u1
(u0, target_picked_up&!target_room_entered) -> u2
(u0, target_picked_up&target_room_entered) -> u3
(u1, target_picked_up) -> u3
(u2, target_room_entered) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !target_picked_up&target_room_entered, u1) -> 1
(u0, target_picked_up&!target_room_entered, u2) -> 1
(u0, target_picked_up&target_room_entered, u3) -> 12
(u1, target_picked_up, u3) -> 11
(u2, target_room_entered, u3) -> 11
